references.text: This verse confirms and expands the genealogy by specifying Oholibamah's origin (daughter of Anah) in addition to repeating the list of sons.
The verse links these same sons directly to their role as chiefs in Edom, which adds theological depth to their identity beyond merely being sons.
The summary in Chronicles confirms the lineage of Esau and integrates Jeush, Jalam, and Korah as part of the official genealogical list in later Israel.
